content:
sam: Quick check — planning to flip short-context quant profile from FP16 -> INT8 in staged rollout tomorrow. Goal: 1% -> 10% -> 50%. Need sign-off and any last-minute guardrails.

anya: Quick Q — do we have per-customer fallback to FP16? And what's the abort threshold for quality regressions?

diego: We do. Flags are: 
```
feature.quant.short_context=INT8
feature.quant.short_context.fallback=FP16
feature.quant.short_context.percent=1
```
Plan: 1% canary, monitor regression evals + user-facing error rates for 6h, then 10% if stable.

li: Perf numbers from staging (INT8 vs FP16): p50 +6%, p95 +10%, token cost -22%, memory -40%. Evals: rouge/accuracy delta < 0.5% on our A/B prompt set (small sample). Dashboard: https://dash.recon/redwood/quant/short-context

emma: I'd like a smoke test on dedicated routing and kv-cache validation — last time INT8 had a KV cache mismatch on longer contexts. Can ops run a couple of traces?

ops-bot: scheduled: quant-smoke-traces for short-context on dedicated pool at 2026-03-18T03:30:00Z by @ops (auto-created)

sam: thanks. I linked PR for feature toggle orchestration: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/487 — needs a quick CR from @diego and @anya

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit/integration/linters) — build #5423

anya: reviewed infra PR, left 2 small nits. Nothing blocking.

diego: will run the smoke traces at 03:30 UTC and watch evals. setting alert if quality_drop > 1% OR p95 latency > baseline + 25%.

sam: ok flipping plan: 1% canary tomorrow 03:30 UTC; hold for 6h. If clear -> 10% 6h later -> 50% gradual over 24h. If any alert fires we force flag -> FP16. I'll update the playbook and publish to #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
